description: Plans and steers organizational change end to end: sizes the change across six impact dimensions, maps stakeholders by influence and impact, diagnoses the source of resistance, builds a phased communication plan, designs training from capability gaps, and tracks adoption with a four-dimension dashboard. Use when the user is rolling out a new tool, process, or structure, needs a change management or adoption plan, wants to handle pushback, draft rollout communications, plan training for a go-live, or work out why adoption has stalled.
